question: Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty, who was conferred with Padma Bhushan in 2020, is a veteran vocalist of the __________ Gharana.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patiala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty** is a renowned Indian classical vocalist who belongs to the Patiala Gharana.
 
• He has been a prominent figure in the field of Indian classical music and has contributed immensely to its propagation.
 
• Patiala Gharana is known for its distinctive style of singing, particularly in the use of intricate and fast-paced taans (rapid fire notes).
 
• Pandit Ajoy Chakrabarty was conferred with the **Padma Bhushan** in 2020 for his contributions to Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gharanas in Indian Classical Music**

 
 
• A Gharana is a system of social organization linking musicians or dancers by lineage or apprenticeship, and by adherence to a particular musical style.
 
• The name of a Gharana typically comes from the name of the place where the style originated or was developed.
 
• Each Gharana has its unique features and techniques, and it influences the way its members perform and teach music.
 
 
 
• **Patiala Gharana**
 
 
• The Patiala Gharana was founded by Ustad Fateh Ali Khan and Ustad Ali Baksh Khan in the late 19th century.
 
• This Gharana is particularly famous for its elaborate use of ornamentation, powerful taans, and intricate rhythmic play.
 
• It places a strong emphasis on the clarity of pronunciation and the emotional expression in performance.
 
• Some notable exponents of the Patiala Gharana include Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan and his son Ustad Munawar Ali Khan.
 
 
 
• **Padma Bhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Bhushan is the third-highest civilian award in India, coming after the Bharat Ratna and the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• It is awarded to recognize distinguished service of a high order to the nation, in any field.
 
• The award was established in 1954 by the Government of India and it is announced annually on Republic Day (26th January).
